mapper.select: SELECT id, appid, ticket, access_token AS access_token, expire_time AS expire_time, create_time AS create_time FROM wechat_sign_cache WHERE appid = #{appid} AND expire_time > NOW() LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wechat_sign_cache (appid, ticket, access_token, expire_time, create_time) VALUES (#{appid}, #{ticket}, #{accessToken}, #{expireTime}, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE ticket = #{ticket}, access_token = #{accessToken}, expire_time = #{expireTime}
